page.content:
2024 climax of Jin against Kazuya's Devil.

How Tekken 8 connects

  • Character: Jin Kazama — Tekken 8 is built around Jin's final confrontation with Kazuya.
  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Tekken 8 casts Kazuya's Devil as the world-ending threat.
  • Topic: Tekken — Tekken 8 is the modern climax of the Mishima blood war.

What is Tekken 8?

Tekken 8 is the numbered entry built around Jin Kazama versus Kazuya Mishima, with Jun's return and Yakushima as the emotional counterweight to the Zaibatsu war.

Key threads lead to Jin Kazama, Kazuya Mishima and Tekken.
